reference.role: Matte 2D illustration, palette and drafted masonry only

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original 16:9 illustration for a full-viewport SAO Minecraft Nameless Codex background, not an illustration inside a card.
Input image 1: STYLE AND PALETTE reference ONLY. Preserve the site's matte 2D anime painted architecture, angular grey-blue stone and supported oak beams. Replace the meeting-room setting with a modest library/archives. Do not copy furniture, do not include the guild banners.
Primary request: A quiet practical archives room in Aincrad. Rectangular blue-grey stone piers, straight oak ceiling beams, two large robust bookcases on the RIGHT wall and one smaller cabinet near the back. Bookcases have four straight shelves with simple grouped muted ochre, dark navy and brown book spines, a few broad closed books laid flat, no lettering or symbols. One long wooden reading table in the lower right has straight attached legs and just two closed books; no chairs needed. A narrow high rectangular window admits cool pale blue daylight. One restrained wall lantern adds a small amber light. Architecturally plausible in Minecraft: broad modular square stone courses, stepped rectangular lintels, angular wooden joinery, intentionally simple geometry. Not a realistic high fantasy cathedral or endless magical library.
Composition: wide eye-level view, disciplined shared perspective. Left third calm blue-black masonry and doorway shadow for sidebar. Middle-left has open shadowed wall and a low empty table edge for title/readable website copy. Interesting bookcases, clear window and reading table on right x60-94%. Four strong vertical masses, three depth planes, simple uncluttered floor in lower third. The room should remain legible when used behind semi-transparent navy interface panels on a 1920x1080 screen and cropped to 390px mobile.
Medium: clearly 2D anime background painting, fine selective ink contours, matte gouache-like color shapes, broad intentional shadow planes, restrained brushwork and simplified book groups. Match the supplied illustrated room. Do not simulate a shiny 3D render, CGI concept art, photo texture or realistic shader screenshot. The painting should feel deliberately composed and carefully drawn.
Palette/light: deep midnight blue #0B141B, desaturated petrol blue #132932, slate stone #1B303B, limited antique gold #BBA47A and ivory daylight. Modest localized cool light from the window, small warm lantern area. No bloom, floating dust or magical glow.
Constraints: no people, creatures, logos, banners, text, labels, pseudo-runes, writing on books, parchment maps, UI or watermark. No magic objects, warped shelves, impossible stairs, decorative spires, oversized arches or piles of random tiny props. Straight supported shelves and table, coherent stone geometry, readable larger forms over fussy detail.
